id: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016)

facts.text: Gnarlack's Blind Pig. Ask for it quietly.
facts.why: The goblin informant who tips off Tina is spelled Gnarlak in the sources, and the speakeasy is the Blind Pig.
facts.fix: Gnarlak's Blind Pig. Ask for it quietly.

vibe.verdict: A good Kowalski ration sheet with the Niffler, Jacob's beast pastries, Occamy shells and the strudel cue, but the food notes are thin.
missing: Frank the Thunderbird over New York (the finale)
ideas: Swap 'Speakeasy lemonade' for 'Queenie's cocoa' ("But we made 'em cocoa.").
Swap the badge and 'Mess open' stamp for a bakery order slip, so the paper matches Jacob's shop.
Swap the note on '1926 New York beef pot roast' for 'Dougal the Demiguise is under the table. Nobody can see him.'
Swap the note on 'Smoked paprika devilled eggs' for 'Occamy shells, Jacob's start-up money.'
iconic: The Niffler stealing shiny things (gougères, signed note)
Jacob's bakery with beast shaped pastries (venue, sign, pastry note)
Occamy silver eggshells as Jacob's start-up money (eggs note)
Queenie and the strudel (cue, strudel note)
Frank the Thunderbird over New York (wink)
changed: Pastry note now Jacob's beast pastries
Devilled eggs note nods to Occamy shells
Gougères note keeps the Niffler and describes the food
Pot roast note now a No-Maj at Tina and Queenie's table
Strudel note uses Queenie's Strudel it is
